messages:
maria_cs: FYI — we've confirmed a regression in the embeddings index affecting ~12 onboarding tenants (search relevance drop). Drafting comms. I can share an exec-friendly status and a personalized outreach template. Need approvals by EOD.
vikram_eng: Thanks — root cause?
andrew_se: Looks like the batch reindex job hit memory pressure during a shard compaction; fallback used stale index for a subset of tenants. Patch is rolling now.
maria_cs: Great. Can we get ETA for full reindex per-tenant?
vikram_eng: ETA ~6 hours for full rollouts. We can fast-track 3 high-touch customers to the front of the queue.
jess_ops: I'll schedule office hours tomorrow 10:00am PT for affected tenants. Should we offer a credit + priority support? Proposal: 10% credit + 2 free support hours for affected accounts.
olivia_csm: For the three high-touch accounts I recommend 15% credit and a dedicated troubleshooting session; for remaining impacted tenants, 7.5% credit and invite to office hours.
andrew_se: Patch verified on staging, rolling to prod. Will post updates in this thread every hour.
deploy-bot: Deployment 17685 completed for service indexer; 5/12 shards recovered so far. Logs: https://deploys.redwood/internal/17685
maria_cs: Draft outbound (short): 'We're aware of degraded search results since 02:15 UTC. We've identified the cause (indexer compaction/memory regression) and are reindexing affected tenants. Expected recovery within ~6 hours. We're scheduling live office hours (tomorrow 10:00am PT) and will proactively apply credits for impacted customers. For urgent needs, contact cs@redwood.io.' Thoughts?
vikram_eng: Add: 'No customer data was exposed; this was an availability/quality issue only.'
olivia_csm: Approve. Can we include a link to the status page and a simple opt-in for priority reindex to make it explicit?
maria_cs: Updated draft sent to legal for quick review. I'm tabulating per-tenant ETA + proposed credit amount now.
andrew_se: Rolling now — next update in 1h.
olivia_csm: I'll start outreach to the three priority accounts with tailored notes and offer to join office hours.
maria_cs: Thanks. Tasks: olivia -> outreach to priority accounts + personalized credit lines; jess -> office hours invite + Zoom + calendar; vikram/andrew -> hourly technical updates and final ETA per-tenant; me -> final public customer note + credit sign-off. This thread = single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
jess_ops: Posted calendar invite and created Zoom link, adding affected CSMs. Invite link: https://zoom.redwood/officehours-17685
maria_cs: Perfect — I'll prep a two-paragraph status and a short FAQ (cause, timeline, how we remediate, credits). Sending to legal now.
olivia_csm: Quick ask — can we include a short feedback form during office hours to capture impact severity and examples? I'll collect for postmortem.
andrew_se: Yes please — we want concrete examples to validate reindex quality improvements.
maria_cs: Noted. Olivia to run feedback capture, Andrew/Vikram to monitor metrics during reindex. We'll compile for the RCA.
maria_cs: One more note: if any partner or high-touch account requests immediate priority outside the 3 we flagged, escalate in #eng-priority and we'll try to accommodate.
vikram_eng: Acknowledged. Updating priority queue now.
